name: tech.aspid.mvvm
description: Aspid.MVVM is a powerful, high-performance MVVM framework for Unity, eliminating reflection, minimizing GC allocations, and removing boilerplate code for faster, streamlined development.

samples.description: The smallest setup: [ViewModel], [View], [RelayCommand]; manual Bootstrap vs ViewInitializer.
MonoViewModel on a GameObject, TwoWay binding and [BindAlso] for a computed property.
OneTime, OneWay, TwoWay and OneWayToSource side by side, built-in and custom converters.
Commands with a parameter, CanExecute, a draft applied to the model on Confirm.
Observable collection synced to child ViewModels, a dialog View spawned at runtime.
A binder for your own component with a generated serializable twin.
Virtualized list with filters and ordering over large data sets.
Properties declared at runtime by id, bound through a plain MonoView with no generated code.
ViewModel resolved from Zenject or VContainer through ViewInitializer.
Compilable snippets covering every generator attribute; no scenes.
